description: Defines the LDAPSyncStatus class representing LDAP synchronization status, including properties for sync times, status, and user info, with ORM mappings and constants for sync states.

classes.name: LDAPSyncStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing LDAP synchronization status with properties, ORM mappings, and constants for sync states.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the sync status record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the sync status record.

methods.name: getSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when sync started.

methods.name: setSyncStartedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when sync started.

methods.name: getSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when sync finished.

methods.name: setSyncFinishedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when sync finished.

methods.name: getSyncedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who performed the sync.

methods.name: setSyncedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who performed the sync.
